response.overview: Lanterns follows new recruit John Stewart and Green Lantern legend Hal Jordan, two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.  As the investigation unfolds, the two Lanterns discover that the case involves secrets and threats far beyond an ordinary murder investigation. Their partnership will test their abilities, beliefs, and relationship as members of the Green Lantern Corps.  The series combines elements of detective fiction, science fiction, mystery, and superhero drama.
response.title: Lanterns
